item.title: Pope Leo XIV in Monaco: where to watch, travel tips and what to expect | Riviera Radio
item.description: Monaco is preparing for a historic, one-day visit by Pope Leo XIV on March 28 (the first ever by a sitting Pope) with large crowds, tight security and major disruption expected across the Principality throughout the day.
